items.title: Sonny Williams Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: We had a seven piece band. Let's see. We had Caleb Hamilton on clarinet, Joseph Bennett on violin, Willie Lee on bass violin, and Ed Atkin on trombone, Usain and I were on trumpet.

ctx.x: home playing guitar. We had a seven piece band. Let's see. We had Caleb Hamilton on clarinet, Joseph Bennett on violin, Willie Lee on bass violin, and Ed Atkin on trombone, Usain and I were on trumpet. Who was the leader? Who was the leader? Caleb Hamilton was leading C clarinet. He would play the melody? Play the melody, the violin part with the C clarinet. So your trumpet part must have been different then? Well during that time, he used to use two clarinet, a B and an A. So he played a violin part with the C…

What would he play? The trumpet play lead? He'd play lead, yeah. He'd play lead then. Trump would play lead, violin lead. So you had the two guys would be both playing lead, the clarinet and the clarinet.
